title: Security Requirements Traceability Matrix (SRTM) Schema
description: Schema for defining and generating Security Requirements Traceability Matrix content as CSV data.

$schema.description: The schema to verify this document against.

$id.description: A unique identifier for the schema.

$comment.description: Comments from schema authors to readers or maintainers of the schema.

title.description: The title of the artifact when generated.

artifactType.description: The type of the artifact to be generated.

outputType.description: The output type of the artifact when generated.

order.description: The order of data properties when generated.

Operating System.description: The operating system installed on the hardware asset.

Installed Software.description: Software installed on the hardware asset.

Applicable STIGS.description: STIGs applicable to the hardware, operating system, or installed software.

NESSUS.description: Nessus scan evidence, result, or reference for the asset.

SCAP/STIG CHKLST.description: SCAP or STIG checklist evidence, result, or reference for the asset.

Notes.description: Additional notes for the SRTM row.

data.description: Data to use for artifact generation.
